title: The Stone and the Frog
lines: Rose digs a hole at home for a rose.
But a big stone is stuck in the hole.
Rose tugs at it. It will not shift.
"We can get it up," said Mom.
Rose gets a rope. Mom gets a long pole.
They tug and tug. The stone pops up!
A frog hops up with a wet nose.
"That stone was my home," said the frog.
Rose sets the stone back in the hole.
The frog hops in. Rose digs by the shed.

questions.ask: Why is Rose digging a hole?
questions.listenFor: To plant a rose. Line one says it. Send them back to that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Tugging on her own does not work. What do Rose and Mom use?
questions.listenFor: A rope and a long pole. Line five. If they name one, ask "and what else?"

questions.ask: Rose put the stone back and dug by the shed. What do you think of that?
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason is right. Listen for something like "the frog gets his home back."
